annotations.text:
Design pass: gate triage modal (board).
Three hosting directions, all reusing the shipped card vocabulary (same tokens, same choice rows, key hints, note field). Each artboard has a dark/light tweak chip; dark is the default since that is where the contrast complaint lives.
Pick a direction; it then gets specced as Storybook stories for sign-off before implementation.
Baseline PNGs of all 22 catalog stories: docs/design/gate-cards/baseline/.

Gate dialog (leading). The spec's shape: one gate per modal, questions as steps, dot-row progress. Opens from the gate chip on a row.
Tradeoff: one gate at a time, no cross-gate flow. Width 560px vs the Modal recipe's 420 default.

Triage queue. One session walks every pending gate on the board; pips track gates, dots track questions inside the active gate, footer peeks the next gate.
Tradeoff: more chrome, and skip-gate semantics need defining (rt has no skip today, so skip = just close and move on).

Drawer host. Comments-drawer chrome instead of a centered dialog; the board stays visible and scannable while answering.
Tradeoff: 380px is tight for long option labels, and there is no dimmed focus on the gate.

Pass input 2: dark contrast on the cards. Left column is today's exact values; right lifts row and control edges, brightens muted text, and gives the checked row an amber wash with a full amber edge. Exact values in the legends. After sign-off these land as board CSS (or kit token) tweaks and apply to cards and modal alike.
Console: follows once the board direction is picked. The same kit adapter renders inside a Mantine Modal with the console's existing questionnaire styling.
